title: Ask tool call
description: What an agent's MCP server sends to POST /app/ask/api/tool, and what the app answers.

tool.description: One of the five built-in tools, or an ability's tool (ability_<name>: code the person allowed for good).

reply.description: The bus's reply: the command's JSON, or an error.

done.description: change_live: how many steps of the batch ran.

undo.description: change_live: the History row that one undo takes back; null when nothing changed.

now.description: change_live: each key written, as [shown text, raw value].

added.description: change_live: the devices added, each {track, device, at}.

failed.description: change_live: the step that failed in Live, {step, what, why}; the steps before it are done.

not_done.description: change_live: the numbers of the steps that were not run.

approved.description: propose_live: the person tapped Do it, and the batch was sent to Live with their word.

declined.description: propose_live: the person tapped Don't. Nothing changed.

unanswered.description: propose_live: nobody tapped in time, or the turn was stopped (then `stopped` too). Nothing changed.

stopped.description: propose_live: the turn was stopped while the card waited.

message.description: propose_live: what came of a card that was not approved, in a sentence.

no_undo.description: propose_live: what the batch did that undo does not take back (a removed device, a new track, code), in words.

removed.description: propose_live: the devices removed, each {track, device}.

made.description: propose_live: the tracks made, each {track, kind}.

ran.description: change_live, propose_live: each code step or ability sent to Live, {step, ok, result, ability?}.

always.description: propose_live: the person tapped Always; `abilities` lists what was kept.

abilities.description: propose_live after Always: the code steps kept as abilities, each {name, tool, replaced}. `tool` is the name to call from now on.

not_saved.description: propose_live after Always: the code steps that were not kept, each {name, why}.

hints.description: propose_live: how a code step could be more general next time. Not shown to the person.

name.description: An ability's tool: the ability that ran.

result.description: An ability's tool: what its code put in `result`.
